summary: Fixed duplicate 'Article Code' column appearing in Article-wise report. Root cause: schema-enabled article_code was leaking into extra_columns even though Article-wise renders it as a native fixed column.
user_report: Why are there two Article columns and one Barcode column in the Article-wise report?
root_cause: audit_routes.py::_get_extra_columns_for_client returns any enabled schema field that is NOT in REPORT_FIXED_COLUMNS = {barcode, description, category, mrp, cost}. article_code / article_name are not in that set, so they were returned as 'extras'. Article-wise report renders article_code, article_name and category as native fixed columns AND also iterates extra_columns to render them again → duplicate 'Article Code'. (Bin-wise and Barcode-wise rely on extra_columns for article_code rendering, so the global set wasn't expanded — fix is scoped to article-wise only.)
fix: In get_article_wise_report (audit_routes.py line 4818-4825), after fetching extra_columns, filter out names in {'article_code','article_name','category'} since those are native fixed columns for the Article-wise view. Other endpoints unchanged.

api_verification.store_barcode_wise: extra_columns=[{name: article_code, label: Article Code, type: text}] (intentionally preserved — barcode-wise needs it)

ui_verification_playwright.column_order: Article Code, Article Name, Category, MRP, Cost, Barcodes, Stock Qty, ...

barcodes_column_note: The remaining 'Barcodes' column (single occurrence) shows barcode_count per article and lets the user expand a row to see child barcodes. It is intentional to the Article-wise view — not a duplicate. Kept as-is.
lint_status: Only pre-existing E702/F841 style warnings — no new issues introduced.
next_actions: User refresh of Article-wise report should show a clean single Article Code column.
